subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: The primary goal of employing open competitive bidding methods in public procurement is to:
options: Prolong the procurement cycle to ensure job security
Favor local vendors over national competitors
Ensure maximum transparency, fair access for all vendors, and obtain the best value for public funds
questions.explain: Public procurement exists to be transparent, foster a fair and competitive environment, and protect taxpayer funds by achieving best value.
